checkpoint_verification: recorded file names and sizes; coefficient_identity.json SHA256

held_sequence_lookup.unseen_token_fallback: global direction mean over the training sequences, separately per head

first_layer_token_identity.interpretation: Equal token IDs give identical first-layer generator inputs, but free coefficients can differ across their occurrences. This bounds reproduction of these chosen oracle directions by any token-only map.
limits: First layer only; later-layer causal representations contain context.
The oracle is independently fitted with target access for every sequence, including those used to test lookup transfer.
The result constrains reproducing these specific coefficient directions, not attainable NLL; other equally good coefficients might satisfy token consistency.
Ignoring early query positions reduces a simple source of coefficient nonidentifiability but does not establish functional identifiability.
first_layer_token_identity.lookup_representative: unconstrained arithmetic mean of unit coefficient directions; its norm may be less than one, making squared-error bounds optimistic

regularized_held_sequence_lookup.selection_objective: mean squared coefficient-direction error across heads; held64 sequences unused for selection

limits: Only 64 uniformly spaced query positions are sampled; every fitting sequence is represented.
A negative coefficient does not imply a negative polynomial value at an observed score.
Positive common scaling is only approximately redundant because output RMSNorm has epsilon and finite precision.
Angular/PCA reconstruction measures coefficient shape, not preserved attention outputs or fitting perplexity.
The sequence split tests a basis on other independently fitted coefficient tables, not unseen-language-model performance.
A five-coefficient polynomial direction already has four intrinsic degrees of freedom; compressible outputs need not be easy to predict from causal inputs.
Oracle activations can contain target information through earlier free coefficients; predictability should first be measured from the original causal parent activations.

settings.angle_weighting: equal sampled sequence/query/head weight; no score, value, gradient, or NLL weighting
settings.axis_reconstruction: keep k coordinate axes ranked by training-sequence variance; other coordinates fixed at training mean
settings.coordinates: factorial(order) times effective monomial coefficient; unit positive L2 normalization for directional statistics
settings.pca_reconstruction: mean plus first k components fitted on training sequences, followed by positive L2 normalization
